<h3>Contra el reloj</h3><p class=\"note\:
Against the clock

Once you have a record, a see-through gold column («Your record») repeats your best run. The trails also start by themselves when you ride through the green start arch.
<h3>Cómo se juega</h3><ul><li><b>Pedalea:
How to play

  • Pedal: joystick forward (W or up arrow); back brakes and, when stopped, goes backwards. Sprint pedals flat out standing up.
  • Turn: joystick sideways; the bike leans more the faster you go.
  • Jump (space, the Jump button or A on the controller): a jump (bunny hop). If you hold it while turning as you land, you skid with the back brake: when you let go you get a boost and points.
  • Tricks: in the air press Jump and choose with the joystick: to one side 360 spin (150), forward Superman (120), back Backflip (300), centred Tailwhip on the BMX (200) or No hands (80). Several in the same jump multiply (combo ×2, ×3…). If you touch the ground with the trick half done, you fall off (not with stabilisers).
  • Jumps: they happen by themselves when you go fast over a roller or a ramp. The longer you're in the air, the more points.
  • Bike park: on the pump track you gain speed by pushing (forward) as you go down each roller; on the half-pipe you go up one wall and come back down the same one by yourself.
  • Prizes: 10 coins for every 1,000 points without getting off the bike; the trophies «Bike park king», «Downhill gold» and «Bike race winner».
<h3>Cómo se lee</h3><ul><li><b>Arriba:</:
How to read it

  • At the top: bike and speed, your points and your record; on a downhill, time, gate and difference from your record (− in green if you're ahead).
  • Yellow column: the next gate. Green arch: start; chequered arch: finish.
  • Map: bike racks (blue square), bike park (orange) and trails (brown line, start in green and finish in black and white).

). Tres bicis: <b>BMX</b> (saltos y truc: ). Three bikes: BMX (jumps and tricks), mountain bike (the fastest on trails and grass) and kid's bike with stabilisers (it never falls). Forward pedals, Sprint goes flat out and the bike leans into corners. Jump does a jump; hold it while turning as you land to skid with the back brake. Rollers and ramps launch you by themselves. In the air, Jump + joystick does a trick: to one side 360 spin, forward Superman, back Backflip, centred Tailwhip (BMX) or No hands; several in one jump make a combo. If the trick is half done when you touch the ground you fall off. The bike park has a pump track (push forward as you go down each roller to gain speed), two table-top jumps and a half-pipe. The downhill trails are timed by themselves when you cross the green arch, with medals and your record as a gold column; with the room, Challenge the room sets up a race. <dt>BMX</dt><dd>Bici pequeña de ruedas d: <dt>BMX</dt><dd>A small bike with 20-inch wheels for jumps and tricks (bicycle motocross).</dd><dt>Bike park</dt><dd>An area with earth and wooden obstacles for jumping and doing tricks on a bike.</dd><dt>Pump track</dt><dd>A closed circuit of rollers and banked corners where you move by «pumping»: pushing the bike down as you go down each roller, hardly pedalling.</dd><dt>Half-pipe</dt><dd>A U-shaped ramp: you go up one wall, come out at the top and come back in the same way.</dd><dt>Table-top</dt><dd>An earth jump with a take-off ramp, a flat part on top and a landing ramp: if you come up short, you land on the table.</dd><dt>Bunny hop</dt><dd>Jumping the bike without a ramp, pulling up on the handlebars and pedals (Jump button).</dd><dt>Back-brake skid</dt><dd>The back wheel locks and slides sideways round the corner; when you let go, the bike shoots off with a little boost.</dd><dt>Tailwhip</dt><dd>A BMX trick: the frame spins all the way round the handlebars while the rider stays in the air.</dd><dt>Superman</dt><dd>A trick where the rider stretches their legs out backwards, horizontally, holding the handlebars.</dd><dt>Combo</dt><dd>Several tricks in the same jump: the points are multiplied by how many you do (×2, ×3…).</dd><dt>Stabilisers</dt><dd>Small wheels on each side of the back wheel so a child's bike doesn't fall over.</dd><dt>Downhill trail</dt><dd>A dirt track down the hillside, timed from start to finish through all the gates.</dd>
